title: Blockout to detail
summary: How you go from a reference to a blockout to the finished model: structure first, then tiers of detail.

request.brief: Model one object twice in the same file: your blockout and your finished version. Put the blockout in a collection named Blockout and the finished model in a collection named Final. If you worked from a reference picture, put it in the file (an image empty or a reference image) or submit it next to the .blend.
must_include: A collection named Blockout with your blockout
A collection named Final with the finished model
The reference you used, if any
request.submit: One .blend file, plus the reference image if it isn't inside the file.

questions.ask: What do you usually start a model from?
How do you block out? (primitives, box modelling, booleans, a kit, something else)
Which order do you add detail in, and when do you stop adding detail?
